dedup: Same assignment id on two pages is one row. Two ids for one nonce are a conflict and the range is not complete.

goldsky_redirect.note: P0 named arweave-search.goldsky.com. This run recorded the live redirect and queried the redirect target directly.

pagination: Repeat the same block min/max with after=last edge cursor until pageInfo.hasNextPage is false. Do not open the next block window on a page that is still open. Do not advance by last_block+1 inside an open page.

pagination_equivalence.note: Page size 2 walks the cursor through blocks that contain more than two assignments. Equality with page size 100 is the check that a short page does not drop the rest of that block.

recovery: Re-request the same block window from the beginning, or resume after the last cursor whose raw body was flushed and hashed. A .part file is not a finished page.
selected_method_for_p4: Walk inclusion height forward from block 1505290. Fully page each closed window before opening the next height. Merge by integer nonce. Use exact Nonce batches of at most 5 only to recheck a set-difference gap. Do not use the uncapped binary search as the bulk index.

tail_locate_stopped.corrected_rule: If max nonce at or before mid is still below the target, the next lower bound is mid+1. See narrow_nonce_search.
tail_locate_stopped.reason: The highest assignment at or before the probe was below the target and sat strictly before the probe. The search advanced only to frontier+1, so an empty inclusion gap was retried until the probe cap. Exact Nonce batches of 5 then returned 2075904..2075923 and matched the P1 tail ids.
tail_locate_stopped.recovered_by: exact nonce tag batches, at most 5 values

why: GraphQL tag filters take exact values. A 50000-value Nonce filter is refused. Block windows are fully paginated with the gateway cursor, then merged by integer nonce.
